verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API, the same one it uses internally. Supporting docs cover personal API key and OAuth2 authentication, introspection and a published schema, an Apollo Studio explorer, exact rate limits, a deprecation policy, a typed TypeScript SDK, and query/mutation examples, which together let an AI-native user drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the API in use (community evidence covers only general product sentiment).
